catalogVersion.description: Semver of the catalog itself, bumped whenever queries change.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Never reuse an id for a different query.

title.description: Human-readable name, shown in the picker.

savedFilterName.description: Shorter name used when installing as a Saved Filter. Required when '[Library] ' plus the title would exceed 50 characters, which the product rejects silently.

category.description: Grouping heading in the picker panel.

query.description: The UAI Advanced Mode query string. May contain {{param:name}} placeholders.

description.description: What the query finds and why it matters operationally.

bestUsedFor.description: Which conversation or workflow this query fits.

proof.description: How to verify a match by drilling into the raw provider attributes behind it.

tags.description: Free-form tags used by the picker's search box.

requiresProviders.description: Providers that must be integrated for this query to return meaningful results. The picker greys out queries whose providers are absent from the current tenant.

params.description: User-adjustable values substituted into the query before it runs.

source.description: Where the query came from. 'derived' means authored against the documented UAI schema.

verified.description: How far this query has been checked. 'counted' means it was run against a live tenant and returned a sensible, hand-checked count. 'syntax-only' means it ran without error but the tenant lacked the data to confirm the result is meaningful. 'unverified' means it has not been run.

name.description: Referenced in the query string as {{param:name}}.

type.description: relativeDate takes a negative integer number of days and renders as a UAI-formatted date.
